profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Fandango (a Versant Media company)
profile.summary: As a Full Stack Developer, I possess comprehensive expertise in both front-end and back-end development, having worked on diverse applications throughout the tech stack. My skill set encompasses popular frameworks like React Native and React.js, as well as proficiency in JavaScript, C#, CSS, Bootstrap, HTML, Java, SQL, Node.js, and Amazon Web Services. Driven by an eagerness to learn and equipped with strong interpersonal abilities, I consistently deliver exceptional results in all my projects.

organizations.name: Association for Computing Machinery
organizations.description: The Association for Computing Machinery (ACM) is an international scientific, academic, and professional organization dedicated to advancing computing as a science and profession.  With a world-wide membership, ACM is a leading resource for computing professionals and students working in various fields of Computer Science, Computer Engineering, and Information Technology.

organizations.name: FSU Engineers Without Borders
organizations.description: FAMU-FSU Engineers Without Borders is a non-profit humanitarian organization established to partner with developing communities worldwide in order to improve their quality of life. This partnership involves the implementation of sustainable engineering projects, while involving and training internationally responsible engineers and engineering students.
